name: lingua³
summary:
lingua³-lingua cube is a single-player block puzzle game.
The player enters the protagonist's head one week before the test and helps him study.
Get an A or above in the final stage test to pass the test!

The protagonist will memorize words by connecting word blocks.
Grab the word blocks that fall and connect them.
Connecting more related word blocks will give you a higher score.
Aim for the highest score (S+, 500,000 points).
